issuer.summary: USDai and sUSDai are issued by Permian Labs; this axis scores the entity, so it is identical for both. The institutional backing is credible — Framework, Dragonfly, Coinbase Ventures, MetaStreet lineage, a Cantina audit with no critical or high findings — but an August walk found an undelayed unlimited-mint path the topology had been credited for not having. OPS_SAFE administers the role gating mint() on all four chains and owns the LayerZero adapter, reaching the same power twice: three keys, one transaction, no timelock, no veto. The 48-hour delay governs upgrades only, and both Safes are 3-of-3 with identical owners. See the full report.

facts: Issuer is Permian Labs. This axis scores the ENTITY, so it is identical for USDai and sUSDai — same operator, same Safes, same audit. It moves on both or neither by construction.
✅ Credible institutional backing: Framework, Dragonfly, Coinbase Ventures and Arbitrum, with MetaStreet lineage and a Cantina audit returning 0 critical and 0 high.

⚠️⚠️ RE-RATED 6.0 -> 5.0 on 2026-08-26 after walking one layer further than the original assessment. OPS_SAFE holds DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE on the token on ALL FOUR CHAINS and therefore administers BRIDGE_ADMIN_ROLE, the role that gates mint(). It ALSO owns the LayerZero OFT adapter, so setPeer reaches the same power by a second route. THREE KEYS, ONE TRANSACTION, NO TIMELOCK, NO VETO — an undelayed unlimited-mint path that was never priced.

⚠️ THE 48-HOUR DELAY GOVERNS UPGRADES ONLY. The rationale being corrected had explicitly leaned on it, calling the topology 'adequate, with a real notice window'. It is a real notice window for the wrong surface.

⚠️ GOV_SAFE and OPS_SAFE are BOTH 3-of-3 WITH THE IDENTICAL THREE OWNERS. The two-Safe structure separates nothing, and CANCELLER = PROPOSER = GOV_SAFE means there is no independent veto on the upgrade path either.
⚠️ 3-of-3 HAS ZERO REDUNDANCY, and it cuts both ways: lose one key and the timelock becomes permanently un-proposable. A threshold equal to the owner count is not a strength.
✅ Verified PER CHAIN rather than by shared address: ProxyAdmin -> 48h OZ TimelockController, bytecode byte-identical on all four chains, ADMIN = self.
⚠️ Held down further by a roughly ten-month track record, a single operator, and no stress test. The entity has not yet been tested by an adverse event.
